operation_details.item: The user always chooses open hot-desking in noisy common areas for on-site client work instead of private meeting rooms or focus spaces.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Morning! How’s the client work looking today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Pretty good. I’m heading on-site this morning to help the operations team work through a few bottlenecks.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Are you setting up in one of the private meeting rooms so you can focus?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Actually, I’ll use an open hot desk in the common area. I prefer the background noise and the chance to overhear what people are working on.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds less formal than the usual consultant setup. Do you find it helps with the problem-solving?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Definitely. It makes conversations more spontaneous, and I get a better feel for how work actually moves through the organization.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: So no elaborate workshop structure today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Not initially. I’ll start with informal conversations at the hot desk and build the approach around what I hear.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Completely forget my preference that For on-site client work, I always choose open hot-desking in noisy common areas instead of private meeting rooms or focus spaces.
